import kivy.app
import kivy.uix.boxlayout
from kivy.clock import Clock
from kivy.lang import Builder

class ScanResultLayout(boxlayout.BoxLayout):
    def __init__(self, **kwargs):
        super().__init__()
        
        self.source = "THINK DEEPLY: Analyze this network scan result for anomalies:"  
        self.target_label = "TARGET"
        self.open_ports_label = "OPEN PORTS"

        self.add_widget(self.source)
        
        Clock.schedule_interval(self.update_scan_info, 1/60)  # Update every minute

    def update_scan_info(self, dt):
        self.source += "\n\n" + f"{self.target_label} {len(self.open_ports)} open ports in the last minute: "
        for port in self.open_ports:
            self.source += f" - {port}"

if __name__ == "__main__":
    root = ScanResultLayout()
    root.get_root()
```
